title: Samuel Hears God
summary: Samuel learned to listen when God called his name. Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him. When life is noisy, Samuel helps kids practice slowing down enough to hear and obey God's Word.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Samuel 3:1-10 like a scene you could retell: who is there, what happens, and what changes?

tell_it: Samuel learned to listen when God called his name. In the story, Samuel heard his name at night and learned that the Lord was speaking. He answered with a listening heart.
understand_it: Samuel Hears God should not be flattened into a slogan. Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him. When life is noisy, Samuel helps kids practice slowing down enough to hear and obey God's Word.
age_5_7_explanation: Samuel learned to listen when God called his name.
age_8_11_explanation: Samuel heard his name at night and learned that the Lord was speaking. He answered with a listening heart. Ages 8-11 can name the Bible detail in Samuel Hears God and the takeaway: listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.
teen_explanation: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him. For teens, the lesson is worth discussing honestly because it connects belief with public choices, private motives, and costly obedience.
key_truths: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.
